title: pvConnectedSurfaceProperties
body:
## pvConnectedSurfaceProperties

Computes the volume, surface area and centroid of each closed object in a polygonal input, plus totals; objects are found as connected components, or taken from an object-ID cell array. Per-object results go to field data (ObjectValidity, ObjectVolumes, ObjectAreas, ObjectCentroids) and per-polygon ObjectIds, Areas and Volumes to cell data. Use it to measure particles, droplets or parts in one surface mesh; use integrate for general integrals.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Objects must be closed and manifold for valid volumes; check the ObjectValidity array before trusting a value.
- Volumes and areas are in dataset units cubed and squared; no unit conversion is applied.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConnectedSurfaceProperties`. Identity: `filters/ConnectedSurfaceProperties`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ObjectIdsArrayName` | This property indicates the name of the array with the object IDs. The default name is "ObjectIds". | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `SkipObjectIdentification` | This property determines whether to skip the object identification which detects the multiple objects in the PolyData. This check can be skipped only if the PolyData has a CellData array with the object Ids, and the ids start with 0 index. The name of that array is configurable. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvConnectedSurfaceProperties",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
